answer_1.quote: We present TACT, a dataset for modeling the integration of task-oriented and chitchat dialogues ... We further adopt Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to align model outputs with human preferences ... The paper focuses on generating dialogue responses (both TOD and chitchat).
answer_1.outputs: Generated agent responses in multi-turn dialogues, including task-oriented replies and chitchat turns.

answer_2.quote: We use three TOD-centric metrics ... (1) Mode Selection Accuracy and F1, (2) Intent Detection Accuracy, (3) Mode+Intent Joint Accuracy ... We also adopt a transition-aware evaluation framework with three categories: TOD‑centric measures, chitchat response quality (i.e., win rate), and transition‑aware flow metrics.

answer_3.quote: The LLM judge (GEMINI-2.5-PRO) assessed sensibleness, specificity, interestingness, and transition naturalness ... We also conducted pairwise comparisons between the target model and GPT-4O ... using GPT-4O‑MINI as a judging model.

answer_4.quote: We also conducted human evaluation alongside the model‑based one. ... 10 evaluators, including both NLP practitioners and general users ... Human annotators evaluated responses on sensibleness, specificity, interestingness, and transition naturalness.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were given evaluation instructions and asked to rate responses on sensibleness, specificity, interestingness, transition naturalness, and overall quality.
